prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. An architectural concept sheet of four original voxel-block creature-duel arenas in a clean 2 by 2 grid, each isolated with an even margin. High three-quarter view. Each is a flat wide symmetrical rectangular playable battle floor with blue and red deployment pads opposite each other, playable portion empty, strong central round battle marking, and distinctive large block-built architecture and foliage outside the play boundary. No people, no creatures, no text, no logos. Realistic Minecraft-style materials and clear buildable block silhouettes. Upper left: basalt quarry pavilion with granite cliffs. Upper right: botanical glasshouse with orderly flowering tree borders. Lower left: icy observatory with pale-blue crystalline buttresses and aurora. Lower right: dry terracotta canyon terraces with sandstone arches.
